name: Expansion loom for MFP panel
family: Context Plus MFP Range Conventional Panels
summary: Non-latching class change sounder input, latching fire & non-latching fault outputs are made possible on the Context Plus MFP range of panels via the FF574X expansion loom. The Context Plus MFP Range of Fire panels provides Auxiliary Expansion Input and Outputs to interface with external equipment. Two Fire outputs and a Fault output are provided. These are of open collector type. These outputs can be disabled via the DISABLE function. A “Class change” input is provided that will activate the alarm sounder outputs from an external command.
